title: Buffer Zones and Spheres of Influence
goal: I can say how much a neighbouring power limits a state with *számottevően*, *drasztikusan* or *szembeötlően*.
I can tell a buffer zone from a sphere of influence.
I can use the main words of geopolitics: *ütközőzóna*, *érdekszféra*, *külpolitikai mozgástér*.

sections.title: Unit 30: Geopolitics, East and West
body: The Carpathian Basin lies between East and West, and Hungarian writers and historians have long discussed what that means. In this unit you recap forms you already know (scalar adverbs, participles before a noun, contrast, purpose) and use them with the vocabulary of geopolitics. The questions are disputed: the texts present views as views.
The reading is a short original text about *Komp-ország*, the image that Ady Endre created for Hungary between two shores.
